projects.name: Concord Engine
projects.line: Holds a fleet of coding agents to one set of decisions, so four workers cannot each answer the same question reasonably and differently.
projects.hook_line: Four green test suites over a broken product, found at integration.
projects.note: source: npm concord-engine 0.3.1 and MCP registry io.github.harsh-chandak/concord-engine 0.3.1, both checked 2026-10-17 against the published tarball. 103 = /^\s*test\(/ across test/*.test.js (contract 40, detect 20, lifecycle 6, logdir 7, routes 10, run 20); 60 = ok-sites in test/e2e-loop.sh, which matches its runtime count; 12 MCP tools asserted by name in test/mcp-smoke.mjs. NO download figure on purpose: npm reports none for this package yet.

projects.name: shadowjoin
projects.line: Measures the matches an exact join is silently dropping, and ranks the normalization rules that recover them.
projects.hook_line: One exact match out of 503 rows. 428 were there all along.
projects.note: source: the scan that ships in the repo, S&P 500 against NYSE/Nasdaq listings: 503 left rows, 6,709 right, exact join 1, recovered 428, verified 419 correct / 1 wrong / 8 ambiguous. Every figure regenerates by running the script. npm shadowjoin 0.3.2. NO download figure: the 747 in npm's last-month window is 705 on publish day and 42 the day after, which is propagation, not use.

projects.name: Job Market Crawler
projects.line: Polls ATS boards directly and ranks every posting deterministically before it spends a single model call.
projects.hook_line: By the time a job reaches LinkedIn, you are late.
projects.note: source: job-hunt DB 2026-09-28 via resume/bullets.yaml — 3,547 enabled boards across 11 ATS; poll_log 396,933 rows over a 14-day window (~28K/day), 336,864 not_modified (84.9%). Was 3,500 and '86% of 1M+ polls' here after the header had already been corrected to the audited figures.

projects.name: TrustMed
projects.line: Answers drug questions by traversing a medical knowledge graph instead of matching text against it.
projects.hook_line: Substitutes with the same active set is a traversal, not a search.
projects.note: source: README, 354,029 concepts and 23M+ edges from the UMLS Level 0 subset

projects.name: ZK-ColdChain
projects.line: Proves a refrigerated shipment broke its temperature limit without revealing the temperature log, then pays out on the proof.
projects.hook_line: Proving a shipment stayed cold normally means handing over the log.
projects.note: source: README; 8°C is the circuit's constraint, Groth16 the generated verifier

projects.name: Maryland Crash Atlas
projects.line: Linked D3 views over public crash reports, where selecting in any chart filters the map with it.
projects.hook_line: Twenty fields, far more rows than anyone reads, and no ZIP on any record.
projects.note: source: final.csv is 32,429 rows over 20 fields AFTER cleaning, which is what the page loads; the raw data.gov export is larger and his LinkedIn entry cites 185K+ processed, so label this one 'mapped' and do not conflate the two. Six views, counted from the SVG ids in index.html: geospatial, splom, heatmap, stacked-bar-chart, tree-map, car-clock. An earlier version of this card said five and missed the treemap.

projects.name: Automated Warehouse
projects.line: Encodes multi-robot warehouse fulfilment as logic constraints and solves for plans where robots never collide.
projects.hook_line: Nothing here searches for a plan. The constraints are simply stated.
projects.note: source: README; instances inst1-inst5, domain from the ASP Challenge 2019
